newsitem.title: USA: Mochida has 5.9 pct Amarillo stake.
newsitem.headline: Mochida has 5.9 pct Amarillo stake.

text.p: Mochida Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said Tuesday it holds a 5.9 percent stake in Amarillo Biosciences Inc or 300,000 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Mochida said it bought the shares in Amarillo's initial public offering on August 13 for $5 per share.
Mochida acquired the securities for investment purposes, the filing said.
Mochida is a Japanese corporation in the business of developing and marketing ethical drugs, diagnostic reagents, skin care products and medical electronics and equipment.
